Startup Name: SignalForge
One Line Description: Evidence-grounded launch intelligence for founders
Problem: founders lose weeks assembling fragmented launch evidence
Solution: an agent turns uploaded materials into a traceable startup profile
ICP: pre-seed and seed B2B founders
Users: founders and strategy leads
Buyers: startup founders
Geography: English-speaking markets
Stage: seed
Business Model: subscription SaaS
Pricing: monthly workspace subscription
Channels: founder communities and accelerators
Competitors: generic chat assistants, research agencies
Assumptions: founders provide at least one business document
Strengths: evidence gaps and contradiction tracking
Weaknesses: market validation requires approved deep research
